title: CPSC, H&M Announce Recall of Baby Denim and Knit Jackets
hazard: The metal buttons can come loose and detach from these garments, posing a choking hazard to young children.

tell: You can identify the recalled jacket by checking the style number 432740 on the laundry care tag inside and H&M on the collar label.
